story:
Four friends carry a man who cannot walk to Jesus, lower him through the roof, and Jesus heals him (Mark 2:1-12, Luke 5:17-26). Grandpa Sol tells the story to Zara, Eli and Pip, with a sing-along song at the end.

Memory verse: "Bring them to Jesus" (Mark 2:3)
Memory line: Bring them to Jesus, He is kind and near!

Talk about it together:
Ages 2-3: How did the friends get the man to Jesus? (Through the roof!)
Ages 4-8: Why did the friends not give up? Who can you bring to Jesus in prayer? How did the man feel when he walked?
Prayer: Dear God, thank You for good friends. Help us bring our friends and our troubles to Jesus. Amen.
Activity (5 minutes): Make a prayer list of friends and family to "bring to Jesus", and pray for each name together.

🎵 Sing along with the lyrics:

[Verse 1]
Four good friends and a man on a mat
Who could not walk, who could not stand
But they said, we know what to do
Let's take him to Jesus, hand in hand

[Chorus]
Bring them to Jesus, bring them to Jesus
He is kind and He is near
Bring them to Jesus, bring them to Jesus
Jesus helps us, never fear!

[Verse 2]
Up on the roof with a rope and a smile
Down through the roof, down came the mat
Jesus looked up, and He saw their faith
He said, get up, you can walk, just like that!

[Chorus]
Bring them to Jesus, bring them to Jesus
He is kind and He is near
Bring them to Jesus, bring them to Jesus
Jesus helps us, never fear!

[Verse 3]
Up he jumped with a joyful shout
Picked up his mat and walked on out
Praising God, so glad and free
Thank You, Jesus, for helping me!

[Chorus - lifted]
Bring them to Jesus, bring them to Jesus
He is kind and He is near
Bring them to Jesus, bring them to Jesus
Jesus helps us, never fear!

[Outro]
Bring them to Jesus!
He is near!

#EliorasBibleStories #BibleForKids #KidsSongs #Jesus
